# Expo Line Plating & Allergen Guide - Dinner Service
Station: Expediter / Saute & Grill Plating
Date: 10/14/2026
Service: 5:00 PM - 10:00 PM

## Table Specifications & Allergies
| Table | Party Size | Dish | Special Dietary Alert |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 14 | 4 | Pan-Seared Halibut | Severe Allium (Garlic / Onion / Shallot) |
| 22 | 2 | USDA Prime Ribeye (12 oz) | Celiac (Gluten-Free) |
| 31 | 6 | Herb-Roasted Half Chicken | Tree Nut Allergy |

## Plating Standards
- Pan-Seared Halibut: Center 6 oz portion over 4 oz celery root puree. Ladle 1.5 oz lemon-caper beurre blanc around the base. Wipe rim with dry linen.
- USDA Prime Ribeye: Slice against grain into 5 thick ribbons. Fan across warmed oval stoneware. Top with compound herb butter round.
- Herb-Roasted Half Chicken: Rest half chicken over roasted fingerling potatoes and glazed baby carrots. Pour 2 oz pan au jus directly over crisp skin.

## Garnishing Instructions
- Table 14 Halibut: Top fish portion with flash-fried leek ribbons and finish rim with smoked sea salt.
- Table 22 Ribeye: Sprinkle with Maldon flaked salt and finish with micro-arugula sprigs.
- Table 31 Chicken: Scatter chopped toasted hazelnuts and charred rosemary sprig at 2 o clock.

## Line Hold Temperatures & Passing Protocols
- Verify hot proteins maintain a minimum internal holding temperature of 140 F before leaving window.
- Sauces on hot well must be held at or above 145 F throughout service.
- Wipe all plate rims with clean towel before releasing to food runner.
- Call all completed tickets to runner station.

errors.quote: Top fish portion with flash-fried leek ribbons
errors.explanation: Leeks belong to the allium family, which directly contradicts the severe allium allergy noted for Table 14 in the specifications table.
errors.fix: Top fish portion with fresh chervil sprigs

errors.quote: Wipe all plate rims with clean towel before releasing to food runner.
errors.explanation: Standard kitchen sanitation protocols require wiping plate rims with a clean towel dipped in sanitizer or using a designated dry food-safe disposable wipe, rather than a generic or dry dirty towel, or omitting the required sanitizer dip designation.
errors.fix: Wipe all plate rims with a sanitizer-dipped clean towel before releasing to food runner.
